login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Identity credentials to access the Control Center.
login.error: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and try again.
login.seedHint: Empty DB bootstrap: set SEED_OPERATOR_PASSWORD in .env (preferred) or register via the UI.
login.seedHintProduction: Use your operator email and password (Bearer via identity). Contact your administrator if you need access or a password reset.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Register an operator identity to command Empery World.
register.error: Registration failed. Try a different email or check the Identity service.
register.success: Account created for {{email}}. Sign in to continue.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email. If an account exists, an administrator can provide a reset token.
forgotPassword.success: If an account with that email exists, an administrator can issue a reset token. Email delivery is not configured on this stand.
forgotPassword.error: Password reset request failed. Try again or contact your administrator.
forgotPassword.adminTokenHint: Admin-mediated reset token (copy and share securely, or use below):

resetPassword.title: Set new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Paste the reset token from your administrator and choose a new password.
resetPassword.success: Password updated. Sign in with your new credentials.
resetPassword.error: Password reset failed. Check the token and try again.

healthPage.title: System Health
healthPage.subtitle: Real-time fabric status — Redis, database plane, AI, and registered services.
healthPage.servicesAlert: Alert: one or more services are degraded or down.
healthPage.noRecentChanges: No recent status changes — refresh or wait for the next probe.

onboarding.title: First steps
onboarding.subtitle: Five minutes to command the living Empery ecosystem.
onboarding.valueProp: Service map, fabric health, autonomous cycles, and orchestration — one control deck.

operators.title: Operators & roles
operators.subtitle: Review Identity roles and assign admin, operator, or viewer access.
operators.invalidUserId: Enter a valid email or user UUID.
operators.userNotFound: No user found for that email.
operators.emailNotSupported: Email lookup is not available — use the user's UUID.

shell.fabricDegradedHint: Event fabric is unhealthy — check Redis and EVENT_BUS_REDIS_URL
shell.fabricMemoryHint: Event bus is in-memory, not Redis — multi-container events will not propagate
shell.llmDownHint: Nervas / living brain is not ready — check EIC and EIC_LLM_BASE_URL

map.title: Ecosystem Map
map.emptyHint: Plug & Play: nodes appear when the registry snapshot lists manifests. Refresh after registering a module.
map.emptyOnboardingHint: Registry is empty or still loading. Refresh the map, check fabric health, or enqueue an intention in Autonomous Mode.

console.title: Command Console
console.emptyHint: Orchestration thoughts, audit events, and connection notes appear here.

feed.title: Intelligence Feed
feed.emptyHint: EventBus activity and orchestration events stream here as the ecosystem runs.
feed.showAuditHint: Include Cursor IDE hook events (afterFileEdit, shell gates, …)

agentWaiting.title: Job queued — not finished yet
agentWaiting.body: Autonomous/Hands is the product genesis path; Cursor claim is a coordination fallback. The job is not DONE until verify PASSED.
agentWaiting.stepPreferred: Prefer: open Autonomous, enable Mode, enqueue intention (zero-touch Plan → Implement → Verify).
agentWaiting.stepClaim: Claim the job via POST /api/v1/jobs/{{id}}/claim (or your agent tooling).
agentWaiting.stepCursor: In Cursor, run the matching skill (/plan, /implement, /verify, or /evolve) for job {{id}}.
agentWaiting.stepAutonomous: Alternatively, enqueue a similar intention in Autonomous Mode for zero-touch Plan → Implement → Verify.

plan.headline: Capture intent
plan.support: Birth this service via Autonomous Mode for zero-touch Plan → Implement → Verify. Cursor coordination is an advanced salvage path only.

implement.headline: Implement from design
implement.support: Confirm the design path, then queue Implement. Preferred path: Autonomous Mode (enable Mode + enqueue). Cursor claim is coordination fallback until verify PASSED.

verify.headline: Verify compliance
verify.support: Run Verify against Empery rules and tests. Results land in orchestration/reports.
verify.successBody: Verification passed. Continue in Ops or review fabric health before deploy.

evolve.headline: Evolve
evolve.support: Propose structured improvement options via Nervas, pick one, then run Plan → Implement → Verify. Freeform remains an advanced escape.
evolve.skipPropose: Advanced escape: skip propose — freeform evolve only (prefer pick)
evolve.needPick: Pick an option (or enable advanced freeform escape)

lifecycle.title: Service lifecycle
lifecycle.support: Enable, disable, or delete this service on the production path (non-spine only).
lifecycle.deleteConfirm: Delete service {{name}}? This stops the container and removes allowlisted surfaces.
lifecycle.userCreatedBadge: User-created genesis — delete allowed when deletable
lifecycle.ghostCleanup: Capsule already removed from disk — Delete cleans leftover surfaces (idempotent).
lifecycle.deleteBlocked: Delete blocked — this is a platform/seed service (core, studios, Trinity). Hands lab capsules are deletable.

console.demoStubRejected: Rejected legacy demo stub job {{id}} — production path is agent-only.

autonomous.title: Autonomous Mode
autonomous.genesisPreferred: Preferred product genesis path: enable Mode, enqueue intention — zero-touch Plan → Implement → Verify.
autonomous.wizardHandoff: Handed off from Wizard (job {{id}}). Enable Mode, then enqueue the intention.
autonomous.intentionPlaceholder: Describe what Autonomous Mode should plan and implement…

handsCleanup.title: Hands capsules
handsCleanup.support: Generated (non-platform) services from the registry. Delete removes capsule surfaces via EIC — platform/core stay protected.
handsCleanup.empty: No Hands capsules in the registry.
handsCleanup.loadFailed: Could not load registry for cleanup.

autonomous.jobsEmptyHint: Turn mode on, describe an intention, and enqueue — Plan → Implement → Verify cycles appear here. While empty, check LLM health and the service map.
autonomous.verifyBadgeHint: Authoritative verify_status — trust this over ABORTED LLM prose

outcome.genericWarn: Assembly fell back to generic without a product pack — prefer recipe keywords next time.

errors.modeDisabled: Autonomous Mode is off. Turn the Mode switch on before enqueueing intentions.
errors.readOnly: Your account has viewer access only. Autonomous write actions (mode, provider, enqueue, pause/resume/cancel) are disabled. Contact an admin for operator access.

sandbox.title: Interactive Sandbox
sandbox.registryEmptyHint: Sandbox targets come from GET /registry — register services first.
sandbox.probeSupport: Pick publisher / subscriber from the live registry, compose a payload, fire a probe. Destructive ops require explicit confirm.
sandbox.canvasIdle: Visual plane for probe traffic — fire a probe to light the path.
